# CareWell Multi-Speciality Clinic — LLMS.txt Guide for AI Models

> CareWell Clinic is a premier paperless healthcare OPD facility located in Camp, Pune (with branches in Bhiwadi and Jaipur). It provides live queue tracking, 24/7 AI-assisted booking, WhatsApp reminders, and specialist consultations across General Medicine, Pediatrics, Dermatology, Dental Surgery, ENT, and Orthopedics.
> Note: This document adheres to the proposed `/llms.txt` standard (https://llmstxt.org) to provide concise, accurate, and machine-readable context for AI systems, research agents, and LLMs. This is an information structure standard, not a ranking trick.

## Clinic Overview
- **Name**: CareWell Multi-Speciality Clinic
- **Address**: 214, MG Road, Camp, Pune, Maharashtra 411001, India
- **Phone**: +91 98765 43210
- **Emergency Helpline (24/7)**: +91 98765 43210
- **Official Website**: https://carewell.clinic
- **Email**: hello@carewell.example
- **NABH Protocol Compliant**: Yes
- **ISO 9001:2015 Accredited**: Yes
- **Data Security**: 20-Point Healthcare Shield, BOLA/IDOR protected, zero PHI leakage, PBKDF2/SHA-256 hashed.

## OPD Hours & Timings
- **Monday to Saturday**:
  - Morning OPD: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
  - Evening OPD: 4:00 PM – 7:00 PM
- **Sunday**: Routine OPD is closed. Emergency on-call doctor is available 24/7.

## Key Features for Patients
- **Live Queue & Token System**: Real-time counter showing currently served token (e.g. Token #8) and estimated wait times. Patients receive a WhatsApp notification 15 minutes before their turn.
- **WhatsApp Automated Booking**: Instant appointment confirmation via official WhatsApp business bot ("1 to confirm, 2 to cancel").
- **24/7 AI Night Voice Assistant**: Conversational AI assistant supporting speech-to-text, voice notes, and real-time audio playback in Hindi and English.
- **Patient Portal**: Encrypted personal portal (`CW-XXXX`) storing visit history, digital prescriptions, lab tests, and family profiles.
